rationale: The Latin anchors *repellere* (to drive back/repel) and *extorquere* (to wrest/extort) point to a sense of forcing or pressing something away compulsorily, which aligns best with thrust.v.02 ("press or force") rather than the purely physical forward-pushing sense of thrust.v.01. The compound *a-nýdan* carries a sense of compulsion/constraint (cognate with *nýdan*, to compel), making the "press or force" synset the closest match.
